gates.title: Primary evidence class is the observed-link graph
gates.detail: all 206 pool lines carry an evidence class {'observed_edge_synthesis': 150, 'legacy_sequence': 41, 'observed_turn_synthesis': 15}; no line uses an unobserved link (class 3 count 0). The headline restriction to observed-link networks binds on a RESULT and is enforced by gate 4-15

gates.title: Peak-express layer frozen and excluded from the graph
gates.detail: routeclass.py defines the peak_express class; exp3_score locks it via lock_classes. Exclusion of express links from the observed-link graph is asserted by the pool build, not re-derived here

gates.title: Stop universe is fixed; no stop created or moved
gates.detail: reconstruction covers 2763 stops against the link graph's 2763; stops_missed=[]

gates.title: Frozen pool contains the current network
gates.detail: 41/41 legacy lines in the pool; 41 reconstructed, 0 failed, stop coverage complete=True

gates.title: Service activation is a real decision (OFF is representable)
gates.detail: frequency.OFF is an infinite headway: zero trips, zero vehicle-hours, zero peak vehicles, unboardable by the path model. build_ladders(allow_off=) is opt-in so Gen1 cannot represent it. The second half -- no synthetic route may be given a copied baseline headway -- binds when the Exp 4 FrequencyModel is built and is armed by gate 4-15's review

gates.title: Search bounds proved inactive on the incumbent
gates.detail: today's local routes run 23.7-99.9 min one way, inside the 10-120 bound, and outside_search_bounds is empty. NOTE: 1 POOL line sits on the bound (pool range 23.3-119.2), so if that line wins, gate 4-6 censors the result

gates.title: Discovery approximation benchmarked, buys no conclusions
gates.detail: the SUBSTRATE half is measured: an assembled network reproduces the legacy scoring path exactly (worst relative difference 0.0 across seven FitnessVector fields, outputs/exp4/equivalence_isolated.json). The gate's own subject -- a frozen supernetwork master path set versus exact per-network rebuilds -- is NOT YET BUILT. What was measured on real Gen2 networks is naive cross-network cache sharing, and it is invalid: worst 1.307 relative on revenue_veh_hours, 0.958 on generalized_cost, though ranking survived (0 inversions in 17 pairs). outputs/exp4/pathreuse_benchmark.json

gates.title: What the optimizer abandons is reported
gates.detail: applies to a promoted network: stops losing service, demand losing access, one-seat rides lost, transfer burden created. Nothing to compute before a network is promoted

gates.title: Path-model adequacy re-established, not inherited
gates.detail: adequacy() exists and measures cached-set cost against fresh RAPTOR. The gate requires it rerun on PROMOTED networks with a deeper max_rounds, the 4->6 paths-per-OD sensitivity redone, and certification on a wider OD set than the top 20,000

gates.title: Common-lines exposure re-measured on promoted networks
gates.detail: the diagnostic exists and reported 0.516% cross-route today; the gate reruns it per promoted network and classifies the result model-dependent if exposure balloons

gates.title: Crowding re-checked on promoted networks
gates.detail: crowding.py exists; it did not bind on the existing network and a greenfield optimizer may concentrate load onto few trunks

gates.title: Demand robustness preregistered before the winner is known
gates.detail: EXPERIMENT4_DEMAND_ROBUSTNESS.md must exist BEFORE any Exp 4 result. Cheap now, impossible later

gates.title: Structural identity uses geometry, not route ids
gates.detail: contract.py computes network_edit_distance_pct with a committed cap; Exp 4 route ids are synthetic so id disagreement is meaningless

gates.title: Search benchmarked on a space that can defeat it
gates.detail: RUN and NOT CLOSED, with the reason measured. The substrate is validated -- every feasible network in four enumerated spaces assembled, scored and ranked, optimum found by exhaustive enumeration. But the four deceptive cases cannot be built on a cheap surrogate: weighted set coverage is submodular (535599 checks, 0 violations), greedy carries a (1-1/e) guarantee there and found the exact optimum in all four. The production evaluator is not submodular, so this gate needs it and the outer search. outputs/exp4/known_optimum_recovery.json

gates.title: Conclusion language is bounded and the null is precommitted
gates.detail: ACCEPTANCE.md bounds the admissible claim and precommits the null as a fine result. Binds on the write-up, enforced by review
